title: Browser session state and migration
summary: A VirtualBrowserSession is a long-lived application state object and is not the same thing as a network connection, egress lease or placement lease.
invariants: Browser session state may include cookies, origin/application state, storage, navigation/checkpoints and timer state.
Credentials remain external capability/secret references and must not be serialized as ordinary session state.
A browser session can acquire and release many API egress sessions during its lifetime.
A job being relocatable does not imply that authenticated browser state is legally or securely relocatable.
Session-state migration must be independently policy-authorised and may require restart from a semantic checkpoint instead of transferring credentials/cookies.

provenance.claim: Browser observer/state remains distinct from Queue Fabric and API Client responsibilities.
Allocator durability/recovery preserves placement/admission evidence without taking ownership of application session state.
